//: Red-proves the RESCUE side of the degenerate-blank-turn retry (ChatStepResult::retryDegenerateTurn): the fixture's first canned body is a blank end_turn (content:[]), which the codec refuses and the runner retries once verbatim; the second canned body is a real completion, so the round recovers and the run reaches final_text having consumed exactly 1 degenerate-turn retry. Companion to error_path.json, which pins the EXHAUSTION case (both bodies blank -> provider_error) -- this one proves the retry is invisible to an ordinary scenario author's checkpoints when it succeeds.
title: Degenerate blank turn then real completion -> rescued, one retry
